prompt: Copper paints the fence bright yellow
title: Bright Yellow Fence
irony: Copper paints the fence bright yellow for buyers who may come next year, but the bright fence gathers today's neighbours instead.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Green, Jade and Copper stare at the old gray fence along the sunny street.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Copper waves yellow paint and talks about next year's buyers while Green recites drying facts.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Lilac arrives with a rule book and says bright yellow breaks the street fence rule.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The crew lifts rollers and sings the yellow fence chant as paint splashes bright.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Green freezes over the paint can instructions while Jade splashes yellow across the sidewalk.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Copper slips in a yellow puddle and lands painted bright yellow as everyone laughs.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The crew dances along the half-yellow fence and sings the yellow fence chant again.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Copper sits on the big house steps with Jade and sees he paints for tomorrow, missing today.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Copper chooses today's neighbours over tomorrow's buyers and lifts the roller with Jade.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: The crew sings the yellow fence chant while Copper sings the turned line about today.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: The crew sings by the old gray fence turned bright yellow as neighbours laugh together today.
